info.syllabusName: Kỹ năng thực hành chuyên môn (Qualification Exam)
info.description:
The test consist of two parts:
Multiple choice (~75 minutes): assess the understanding of theories, and the applying theories to business cases.
Constructed response test (~75 minutes): assess the ability to solve human resources management problems.
